correctness.rationale: The complete negative-curve list follows from adjunction and the five-point collinearity assumption, and the negative-definite-support criterion follows from the -2 Schur complement. The exact matrix checker agrees with that criterion on all 8192 possible supports, yielding 285. The full Weyl group (1920) and R stabilizer (48) are enumerated with integral root reflections. The A3 plus A1 generators give the ten S4 x C2 classes; each exact fixed-support polynomial agrees within its full class. Weighted Burnside count 1440/48=30 equals direct orbit enumeration; all values are for the stated conditional finite geometric action, with descent proved using invariant negative divisors.

value.rationale: The one-A1 quartic del Pezzo is a geometrically distinguished degeneration with a unique exceptional (-2) curve. Frobenius-stable supports classify arithmetic descent of big-linear-series chambers. The exact ten-class distribution and 30 geometric orbits reveal previously unavailable Galois behavior: a class with only three of 285 chambers stable, despite nonzero positive-dimensional support strata in geometric counts. This is a complete, motivated classification, not an arbitrary graph slice or recomputation of the known total.
